_comment: Procedures that accept a client-supplied identifier but legitimately do not reference ctx.businessId/ctx.tenantId. Each key is `<namespace>.<procedure>`; each value is a one-line justification. See scripts/check-ownership-scoping.ts. Adding an entry here is a deliberate IDOR-safety waiver — only add genuine false positives (id IS the scope, scoping delegated to a helper, control-plane/unauthenticated endpoint).

allow.auth.nativeAuthorize: Pre-tenant control-plane endpoint: the native-auth request id is the scope and the request is bound to the caller's own cookie session (ctx.user.id); bearer/API-key callers are rejected.
allow.auth.nativeRequestInfo: Pre-tenant control-plane endpoint: the unguessable native-auth request id is the scope; returns only non-sensitive consent-page info and NOT_FOUND for expired/consumed ids (the code exchange itself requires PKCE).
allow.auth.revokeSession: Control-plane sessions table; scoped by ctx.user.id (eq(sessions.userId, ...)), not by business/tenant.
allow.selfExport.request: Scopes on input.tenantId by validating the caller is an owner-role member of that tenant via controlDb tenantMembers.
allow.selfImport.request: Scopes on input.tenantId by validating the caller is an owner-role member of that tenant via controlDb tenantMembers.
allow.tenant.acceptById: Invitation is bound to the caller's identity: scoped by eq(invitations.email, ctx.user.email) (plus unaccepted/unexpired).
allow.tenant.select: Tenant switch is authorized by verifying ctx.user.id is a member of the target input.tenantId before updating the session.
